assets.title: Create workspace
assets.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Produce exactly ONE polished product UI concept image, not code. The concept is a clean enterprise email-to-quotation automation workspace for Medmack. Make this exact requested screen the active page. Dialog requests show only ONE modal over that page, not floating extra screenshots. Elegant practical desktop typography, wide margins and meaningful information density. NO phone, NO collage, NO montage, NO inset screenshots.
